scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of Poisson factorial moments and exact normalized kernel; finite checker is corroboration. Published printed coefficient independently checked by rank/trace. Novelty risk of equivalent contingency-table interpretation disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed k>=3 before n tends to infinity; only irreducible (kn-2,2) projection, no joint k,n limit or intermediate lp norms. Known pair-overlap spherical structure and zero-event asymptotic are prior work.
title: A Poisson asymptotic for sharp Fourier projection norms on uniform set partitions
